---
title: "ClassComp"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
class_comp <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dwillis/jour405/refs/heads/main/data/class_comp.csv")
```
```{r}
summary(class_comp)
```

```{r}
class_comp |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(first_year, sophomore, junior, senior, grad_student),
    names_to = "class_year",
    values_to = "count"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = count)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ class_year, scales = "free_y")
```
